description: A forum post or reply. Lives in the author's user repo; references its thread via strongRef.

community.description: DID of the community (denormalized for scoping).

root.description: The forum.thread this post belongs to.

parent.description: The post being replied to; absent for top-level posts.

embeds.description: Optional media attachments stored as blobs (see blob config).

author.description: The member who wrote this record. Present when the record is stored in the community's repository (a private community) and not in the author's own.

importedFrom.description: Present when the post was imported from another platform (net.openfederation.forum.importBatch). Such a post is written by the community itself, in its own repository, never in the name of the original author.
Where an imported post came from. `createdAt` keeps the original time; the repository commit carries the time of the import.

channelId.description: The source platform's id of the channel or thread the message was in.

messageId.description: The source platform's id of the message.

author.description: How the original author is shown. By default a label local to one import ("Discord member 3"); the original display name only when the importer chose to copy names. Never an identity: the record is the community's.

editedAt.description: When the message was last edited on the source platform.

attachmentCount.description: How many attachments the message had. Attachments are not imported.

authorSig.description: The author's signature over this record without `authorSig`. Present together with `author`.

key.description: did:key of the author's atproto signing key.

sig.description: base64url signature over the CID of the record without `authorSig`.
